integrity: All counts and the integer Morse boundary are regenerated from an explicit finite simplicial definition using the bundled standalone Python 3 checker; no outside data files or unverifiable precomputed certificates are used.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification for the triangular graph T7 alone; no larger-family theorem, integral automorphism representation, or independent validation. Previously published mod-two homology does not imply integer attaching-map vanishing.
title: The triangular graph on seven points has a mixed-dimensional integral sphere-wedge neighborhood complex
